security_semantics_audit.basis: Integrity, foreign-key, and required-pragma failures use GKOS_P6_AUTHORITY_CORRUPT; byte-length and manifest-digest mismatches use GKOS_P6_EVIDENCE_MISMATCH. All five leaves forbid accepted result, publication, authority mutation, event, and success activity.

Insertion coordinate, duplicate-sequence, and kind/table mismatches use GKOS_P6_STATE_CONFLICT with full rollback; startup corruption uses GKOS_P6_AUTHORITY_CORRUPT and blocks the gate; generated duplicate event_id uses GKOS_P6_IDENTITY_COLLISION with one entropy call, no retry, no overwrite, and zero mutation.

Live-resolution physical drift uses authenticated-redacted GKOS_P6_RESOURCE_NOT_FOUND with zero replacement-object access. Restart-invalidated reference-bound cursors use GKOS_P6_REQUEST_STALE_AUTHORITY before any reference or snapshot lookup and require rediscovery.

A clean initially preexisting final locator, including RESTORE-OWNER-004, uses GKOS_P6_STATE_CONFLICT; post-qualification identity or existence change uses GKOS_P6_MIGRATION_RECOVERY_REQUIRED. Both forbid overwrite, deletion, hybrid publication, and secret re-reveal.

Precommit admitted, final-gate, prepared-effect, and uncommitted-anchor cuts become durable stale with GKOS_P6_REQUEST_STALE_AUTHORITY. Later source-controlled durable cuts have distinct deterministic replay or recovery leaves without duplicate results or effects.

Seven malformed, absent, unknown, mismatch, disabled, and revoked credential leaves are byte-identical GKOS_P6_AUTH_FAILED; sole-owner rotation, zero grace, issuance epoch, one-time handoff, and no re-reveal rules are present. Residual open and bundled credential fixtures are findings below.

Deny, indeterminate, timeout, missing or reordered private dependencies, public invocation of private dependencies, bounded reason codes, persisted microtokens, and unknown-selector caps fail closed. Residual modal and bundled race/rate fixtures are findings below.

The exact six-field additionalProperties:false error envelope, 53-code membership, INTERNAL_ERROR path/SQL/stack projection, and real-input fixture rejection are closed. REDACTION-HANDOFF-ERROR-001 still has an unnamed conditional public outcome.

Mapping add and revoke remain GKOS_P6_PLATFORM_UNAVAILABLE without mapping-existence disclosure before a separately ratified authenticated adapter. The mapping evidence record, collision-guard field/domain/preimage/algorithm/equality, adapter binding, and executable subject-digest-collision qualification are deferred together.

RESTORE-OWNER-001 through RESTORE-OWNER-009 match the original D0 meanings: success, old/new credential behavior, locator-stage recovery, initial conflict, candidate/intent recovery, plan-stage temp recovery, absent temp, unsafe/aliased temp, and abort-event/external-plan reconciliation. Valid staged evidence auto-resumes; abort remains a separate authenticated operation.

findings.title: Registry V2 still contains open or unnamed security projections
evidence: REDACTION-HANDOFF-ERROR-001 expects an 'ordinary content-free failed-delivery outcome' without selecting an exact success result or one of the existing 53 error codes, and then adds 'unless actual exposure rule independently fires', leaving two possible public projections under one ID.
CREDENTIAL-LOCATOR-BINDING-001 says delivery 'may succeed exactly once'; it does not freeze whether delivery succeeds in this schedule or the exact result/error bytes.
RACE-DISABLE-AFTER-GATE-001 and RACE-REVOKE-AFTER-GATE-001 say the already-final-gated request 'may publish' rather than freezing publication or nonpublication and one exact result.

These modal and conditional outcomes conflict with Registry V2 closed_fixture_semantics.expected, V4 descendant_acceptance_requirements, Map V2 Q3/DC06, and V5 acceptance_rule, all of which require one deterministic response or error per canonical ID with no alternative outcome.
findings.impact: A successor-F1 author would have to choose public result/error semantics and publication behavior. That is a security-semantic contribution and prevents proof of byte-identical redaction, exact final-gate behavior, and deterministic handoff handling.
findings.required_disposition: Remain stopped and return to the Product Owner. A new owner-ratified descendant must select an exact result or existing 53-code projection for each case and replace every modal 'may' outcome with one mandatory deterministic outcome before fresh C1 review.

findings.title: Several canonical IDs still bundle multiple executable security leaves
evidence: CREDENTIAL-RESULT-002 combines idempotent replay of credential.issue and credential.rotate under one ID; CREDENTIAL-RESULT-004 combines issue and rotate plus failed and acknowledgement-lost delivery states under one ID.
RATE-AUTH-FAILURE-004 combines backward and forward wall-clock divergence in one input even though those are distinct injected schedules and cap behaviors.
REQUEST-STALE-001 ranges across loss of principal, session, policy, and recovery bindings in one ID rather than one binding loss per executable leaf.

SNAPSHOT-RESTART-001 claims byte identity across former reference/snapshot states described as live, dead, absent, and corrupted, but defines only one canonical ID and no closed parameterization that materializes those distinct initial states.

ERROR-ENVELOPE-001 places one instance of each of 53 error codes under one canonical ID; RETENTION-CRASH-001 explicitly requires separate precommit and postcommit runs; RETENTION-ANCHOR-INTENT-001 injects a crash at each of several durable boundaries under one ID.

ANCHOR-INTENT-007 ranges across omitted and null forms of four digest fields; ANCHOR-PHYSICAL-PROTECTION-001, BOOTSTRAP-SOURCE-MALFORMED-001, BOOTSTRAP-SOURCE-MALFORMED-003, COLLISION-ENCODING-BASE64URL-001, COLLISION-ENCODING-DIGEST-001, and COLLISION-ENCODING-UUID-001 each aggregate multiple independently testable malformed or physical-negative inputs despite the registry rule that a negative input changes only the field named by that leaf.

The registry declares that ranges and prose bundles are expanded and that one ID has one deterministic initial state, schedule, response or error, allowed/forbidden mutation set, restart sequence, and exhaustive post-state. These rows do not satisfy that declared rule.
findings.impact: The structurally correct count of 265 IDs is not an exact count of 265 one-leaf executable cases. Splitting or formally parameterizing these cases changes fixture bytes and may change canonical counts, aliases, family totals, Map V2 bindings, and the V5 ratified coordinate.
findings.required_disposition: Remain stopped and return to the Product Owner. Produce a closed replacement registry with one executable initial state and schedule per ID, recompute exact counts and hashes, regenerate only later acyclic descendants, obtain a new exact-byte owner ratification, and restart C1.

source_controlled_mechanical_corrections.required_action: Remove modal 'may' language. The positive qualified handoff deterministically completes exactly once with the existing one-time nonsecret result rule. A request whose final gate wins deterministically publishes its already-authorized result, after which disable or revoke governs only later work.

Materialize locator and pipe handoff qualification separately where their physical schedules differ; materialize credential.issue and credential.rotate replay/failure schedules separately. Preserve the current canonical ID for exactly one source-controlled branch and allocate distinct additional IDs for every other branch without changing the named eight-ID subtotal.

Materialize backward and forward clock divergence separately; materialize principal, session, policy, and recovery binding loss separately; materialize each claimed former reference/snapshot condition separately while preserving Q2 restart precedence and byte-identical GKOS_P6_REQUEST_STALE_AUTHORITY.

Materialize each error-code instance as its own executable leaf or bind an owner-ratified closed parameterization that is explicitly counted as separate executable cases; materialize precommit and postcommit retention crashes separately; materialize each named retention anchor crash cut separately.

Expand every omitted-versus-null, field-specific, physical-protection, malformed-token, and noncanonical-encoding negative so each executable leaf changes exactly one named field or one named physical condition and has one exact schedule and result.

After BCI-OWNER-001 is decided and BCI-MECH-001 through BCI-MECH-005 are materialized, recompute the canonical-ID total, additional-fixture count, all 16 family totals, aliases, raw hashes, byte lengths, and internal digests; regenerate only later acyclic descendants and restart fresh C1.

bounded_correction_inventory.minimum_safe_disposition: No implementer or reviewer may silently reinterpret, parameterize, split, rename, or select outcomes under the V5 coordinate. Return to the Product Owner with BCI-OWNER-001 and preserve all reviewed bytes.
